scope: Efficiency of existing selected checkpoints, seed5576 representative weights; no training or selection.
execution: All benchmarks serially on the same idle RTX3090; FP32, existing eval/no_grad path, CPU threads4.
block_selection: Five deterministic evenly-spaced contiguous blocks per batch size from the full dev split; original sequence padding and cache word padding.
latency: Synchronized wall time and CUDA events, resident model and one input batch on GPU; no analysis hooks, model loading, tokenization, disk IO or host-to-device transfer in timed model call. Report median/p95 and per-block medians; these are timing repeats, not training seeds.
memory: Peak allocated and reserved CUDA bytes of a warmed forward; also resident allocated bytes and incremental peak. Only one input batch resident. Model itself stays resident.
parameters: Total registered parameters, trainable parameters, frozen correlation parameters, buffers and FP32 weight bytes. Separate one-time frozen BERT cache generator.
complexity: Analytical dense arithmetic FLOPs from actual forward shapes: Linear, Conv1d, QKV/output projections, attention QK/AV products, FFNs, MoE gate projections and actual dispatched expert rows, fusion matmul. One multiply-add=2 FLOPs. Bias, normalization, activation, softmax, pooling, embeddings, indexing, routing comparisons and elementwise scaling excluded and documented. Independent profiler operator totals for cross-check.
correlation_timing: Additional independent timing of exact _correlation_signals call at identical inputs; measured separately, not subtracted from end-to-end timing.
constant: Benchmark current unoptimized control which still computes correlation features before substituting constants.
cache: Rebuild the original fixed_word_features cache in a fresh output directory, batch16, once for each dataset train/dev/test; original caches unchanged. Measure total wall time including hashes, loading, tokenization, encoding, pooling and serialization; record file bytes, GPU peak and generator parameters. Validate IDs, retained words, audio/visual tensors, text replay error against original frozen caches. Operating-system file cache not flushed.
validation: Strict source/checkpoint/cache hashes; dev prediction replay agreement; instrumentation equality; FLOP count checks on synthetic Linear and Transformer shapes; all results and code hashed.
